result.title: CivilCADBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Understanding, Reconstructing, and Designing Civil Engineering Drawing Sets
result.summary: Civil infrastructure is designed, built, and maintained through engineering drawing sets, yet preparing and revising them remains labour-intensive and calls for automation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are promising candidates, but assessing them requires a benchmark grounded in real engineering practice. We introduce CivilCADBench, a benchmark for understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets, built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities. Unlike parametric 3D CAD models, these drawings are dense, layered, and multi-sheet; and since prints are lossy projections with no pixel trace of layers, a file can print correctly yet remain wrongly organised. CivilCADBench comprises three task families of increasing difficulty: understanding tasks are evaluated with 2,183 expert-reviewed questions ranging from single sheets to whole sets, while reconstruction and design tasks are agentic, requiring models to rebuild printed pages as editable CAD files, either as single pages or entire drawing sets, and to produce new designs. These tasks are performed across 232 pages, 28 sets, and 19 design tasks, and evaluated by a deterministic scorer that compares model outputs with the designers' source files on geometry, layers, text, and dimensions. We evaluate seven frontier MLLMs on CivilCADBench, and find that they read and redraw printed content accurately but recover the file structure poorly: the best model scores above 90% in understanding and single-page reconstruction, yet only 60% on layer assignment and 48% on design. Grounded in real engineering practice, CivilCADBench exposes both the capabilities and the limitations of frontier models in professional civil engineering, laying a foundation for next-generation models and agentic systems for intelligent civil engineering.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CivilCADBench：基于真实土木工程图纸及源 CAD 文件（超过 25 万实体）构建基准，包含专家审校的理解问答，以及需要模型重建可编辑 CAD 文件、完成整套图纸与新设计的 agentic 任务，并用确定性打分器在几何、图层、文字和尺寸上与设计师源文件比对，评测七个前沿 MLLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心发现——模型能准确读取与重绘打印内容，却难以恢复图层等文件组织结构——可作为多模态模型是否保留「像素中不存在但任务必需」结构信息的诊断线索；但该工作面向土木绘图域，未涉及 latent 状态生成或推理机制，故仅需按需查阅。
